tasks.title: State machine and semantic operations with per-task preconditions
tasks.desc: Implement the transitions and role table of §2 as semantic ops (propose, batch, approve, edit, withdraw, depend, undepend, start, pause, note, ask, answer, finish, accept, send-back, reopen, set-yolo). Each op carries the hash of the tasks it reads; if any changed → conflict, otherwise apply on the latest document (§5). New ids use and bump `seq`.

finish requires a summary note; send-back requires a feedback note; start on a blocked task is rejected

notes.text: Created from docs/roadmap.md, approved by the human in Phase 0 (2026-10-31). See docs/esquema-tareas.md for the spec.

packages/core/src/ops.ts: applyOp(doc, op, ctx) — pure semantic ops (propose, batch, add-group, approve, edit, withdraw, depend, undepend, start, pause, note, ask, answer, finish, accept, send-back, reopen, set-yolo) with the role table of §2 (human/agent/konsora), run scope (an agent inside a run acts only on its task, may still propose), per-task preconditions (expect: taskHash per task read → conflict with the current task; other tasks never conflict), new ids from seq, notes numbered, YOLO (turning on approves the chain, intermediates finish to done, the YOLO task to review and YOLO ends), runtime edit whitelist, final validateDocument. tasks.title: File store: PID lock, atomic write, fsync and watcher
tasks.desc: Store for `.konsora/tasks.json` per §5: O_EXCL lock with {pid, host, at}, stale only if the PID is dead on the same host, 5 s wait; read → validate → apply op → validate → canonical write to temp + fsync + rename + dir fsync. Invalid files are never overwritten. Watcher with hash comparison and 100 ms debounce. Opening never writes; `.konsora` symlinks are rejected.

acceptance.text: Test with two real child processes interleaving 200 ops: none lost, final file valid
Invalid file on disk → write rejected and file bytes unchanged
External edit is reported by the watcher within 300 ms
Workspace checks pass

notes.text: Created from docs/roadmap.md, approved by the human in Phase 0 (2026-10-31). See docs/esquema-tareas.md for the spec.
Started: file store per §5: O_EXCL PID lock, atomic write with fsync, invalid files never overwritten, watcher with hash comparison.

packages/core/src/store.ts (exported as @konsora/core/store, Node-only): readTasks (never writes; rejects symlinked .konsora or tasks.json), mutate (O_EXCL lock with {pid, host, at}; stale only if its PID is dead on this host, compare-and-delete takeover, no time-based expiry; re-reads and validates under the lock; invalid files never overwritten; canonical write to temp + fsync + rename + dir fsync; op errors returned without touching the file), watchTasks (fs.watch + debounce + content hash; ignores lock/temp files and same-bytes writes; reports changed/invalid/missing). Tests: two real child processes interleaving 200 proposes lose nothing and leave a valid file (mutation-checked: without the lock the test fails), invalid file bytes unchanged, external edit reported in < 300 ms, live/foreign/dead locks, symlinks. npm run check green (226 tests).
Accepted under the human's standing authorization in chat (2026-10-31): "De momento, hasta que no tengamos la UI real funcionando puedes dar por aceptadas todas las tareas. Puedes seguir."

notes.text: Created from docs/roadmap.md, approved by the human in Phase 0 (2026-10-31). See docs/esquema-tareas.md for the spec.
Started: agent write commands (propose, batch, edit, withdraw, depend, undepend, start, pause, note, ask, finish) through core ops and the store, with --as / KONSORA_AGENT.

Agent write commands in packages/cli/src/write.ts, each one core op applied through the store: propose (--desc, --criterion…, --deps, --labels), batch (JSON from stdin or --file, all-or-nothing, deps by id or earlier title, strict shape), edit/withdraw/undepend (proposals only, enforced by core), depend (cycle-checked), start/pause (optional note), note/ask (text from argument, -m, --file or --stdin), finish (--summary/--summary-file/--stdin). Human transitions are absent (approve/accept/send-back/reopen/yolo are unknown commands). store.mutate now tags errors by source (op/store). Tests: 26 e2e (batches with a cycle-like later-title dep, unknown dep or unknown group write nothing; impersonation refused; no agent sequence reaches done). npm run check green (271 tests).

Tests: 32 contrast pairs × 2 themes pass AA, generated CSS freshness, component semantics. Screenshots reviewed in both themes; fixed a theme flash (theme now applied before first render). Next: phase 3, navigable mock app with fake data.

Phase 3 built: navigable mock app (npm run dev -w @konsora/web; gallery at #/muestrario).
